data.name: Aus
data.gender_notes: Aus is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘AUW’, meaning ‘bird’. In Islamic culture, the bird symbolizes freedom, happiness, and elevation to higher realms. The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) is reported to have said, his companions, ‘The angels descend on the earth in the form of birds’, emphasizing the spiritual significance of birds. The name Aus carries the meaning “Bird” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aus usually hope their child will grow to embody bird and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of freedom and elevation to higher realms.
data.etymology: Aus belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bird.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aus total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: أوس
in_arabic.meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي يعني الهدية أو العطية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة 'أوس' التي تعني الهدية أو العطية. يعتبر اسمًا محمودًا في الثقافة الإسلامية، وقد ورد ذكره في بعض الأحاديث النبوية. يتميز حامله بالكرم والسخاء، ويُعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة وطيبة.

in_hindi.name: औस
in_hindi.meaning: एक पुल्लिंग नाम जिसका अर्थ है उपहार या दान
